definitions.gloss: bulk buying; buying in quantity; purchasing multiple items at once
definitions.explanation: the practice of buying many items or large quantities at one time, often to save money or time

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとめ{買|が}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do bulk shopping on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まとめ{買|が}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{得|とく}→お得：07739_otoku⟧だ。
examples.english: It's more economical to buy daily necessities in bulk.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧まとめ{買|が}いしすぎた。
examples.english: I bought too much stuff at the sale.

notes:
Compound of ⟦まとめ→まとめ：10506_matome⟧ (combining, from ⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧) + {買|か}い (buying, with rendaku → がい). Refers to purchasing many items or large quantities at once.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- まとめ{買|が}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to buy in bulk
- まとめ{買|が}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get cheaper by buying in bulk
- まとめ{買|が}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bulk-buy (suru verb usage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}いだめ→買いだめ：08047_kaidame⟧: stocking up, hoarding (implies storing for future use)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧: large-quantity purchase (more formal)
- ⟦ついで{買|が}い→ついで買い：08075_tsuidegai⟧: impulse add-on purchase
- ⟦{衝動|しょうどう}{買|が}い→衝動買い：07691_shoudougai⟧: impulse buying

CULTURAL NOTE:
With the popularity of コストコ (Costco) and online shopping, まとめ{買|が}い has become increasingly common in Japan. Supermarkets also offer まとめ{買|が}い discounts.
